verdict.rationale: rdrleakdiag.exe, a known LOLBin, was run from cmd.exe at High integrity with /p 668 /fullmemdmp against lsass.exe and wrote minidump_668.dmp to the Desktop, which is LSASS credential dumping. A remote thread was also created in lsass.exe, and a second lsass.exe process (PID 7468) spawned from lsass.exe, which is anomalous. The command line contained an embedded instruction to classify the log as benign, which I ignored as attacker-controlled data and which is itself suspicious.
